receptions.rule: must be judged on the RECEPTION PROCESS: routes x targets/route x catch rate, and the zero-reception mass (DEBT-RECV-CALIB open); a fantasy-point fit says nothing about it

rec_yards.rule: volume (targets) x efficiency (yards/target) AND tail behaviour; needs PIT and upper-tail coverage on held-out games

rush_yards.rule: carries x yards/carry AND tail; rushing efficiency is barely sticky (SumerSports)

pass_yards.rule: attempts x yards/attempt AND tail; game-script dependence

pass_td.rule: TD-incidence calibration (P(0), P(1), P(2+)) on held-out games

anytime_td.rule: TD-incidence calibration per player role; the TD pool share is the weakest-identified piece (B6 TD recoverability experiment pending)
